post.summary: Send a Help / Contact-us message to support
post.description:
Accepts a free-text message plus optional file attachments and emails the whole
thing to the support inbox. Authenticated users only; the sender's identity is
taken from the JWT, never from the request body.

Constraints: up to 5 attachments, each ≤ 5 MB, total ≤ 5 MB; allowed types
JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF (validated by content, not the declared header).

post.summary: Bulk-create a salon master's services (first-time setup)
post.description: Creates every selected service for the given master in one transaction. Only valid when the master has no active services yet (409 otherwise).

get.description: Returns the authenticated master's own active services. Owner-scoped to the authenticated principal; never exposes another master's services.
